images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable poster composition. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. In a cramped apartment kitchen at dawn invaded by a medieval sky castle vault opening, the patriotic shield-bearing symbol hero performs a mid-air twist while gripping an unbranded shield beside a floating brass time compass. Reversed-time arcs freeze cups and harmless crumbs; a poster-like central silhouette and warm dawn backlight make the event clear. The culprit is hidden in the cat's pink-nose reflection, while the rescued crowd erupts in celebration in the kitchen doorway. Include Ancient vault opening, the rescued crowd erupts in celebration, the culprit is hidden in the cat's pink-nose reflection, triumphant heroic expression, mid-air twist, poster-like central silhouette, one decisive action, bright, clearly separated suit colors, no exact emblem, safe wire compositing, realistic paws and reflections. No text, logo, watermark, famous artwork, franchise design, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, duplicate limbs, or human features.
Required assigned visual details: no official logo, no exact emblem, no exact costume copy.
